name: old_hours_per_cycle
meaning: ASSUMPTION - analyst time per reporting cycle the old way: run many sliced KQL queries, export each, merge and check in Excel. Replace with a measured baseline from the vulnerability team.

name: old_report_cycle_days
meaning: ASSUMPTION - how often the old manual report is produced (weekly). A new critical can wait up to this long before it appears in a report.

name: old_dashboard_days
meaning: ASSUMPTION - elapsed time to produce the executive dashboard the old way.

name: review_minutes_new
meaning: ASSUMPTION - time someone spends reviewing the automatic dashboard each cycle.

name: example_estate_rows
meaning: ILLUSTRATION - vulnerability rows in a large company estate, used only to show how many KQL queries the old way would need.
